478.name: strict_num
478.docs:
A collection of bounded numeric types.

Includes:

- [`FiniteF32`]
- [`FiniteF64`]
- [`NonZeroPositiveF32`]
- [`NonZeroPositiveF64`]
- [`PositiveF32`]
- [`PositiveF64`]
- [`NormalizedF32`]
- [`NormalizedF64`]

Unlike `f32`/`f64`, all float types implement `Ord`, `PartialOrd` and `Hash`,
since it's guaranteed that they all are finite.
